wire_rules.descriptors: All file references exact{path,bytes,sha256} for raw UTF8 file bodies; no implicit canonical-JSON hash. Arrays separately typed/shape/unit checked only in later science selection.
wire_rules.strict_JSON: No duplicate keys, bool-as-int, NaN/Inf, arbitrary extra fields; bounded extent before parsing.
wire_rules.ids: Immutable job_id derived from full canonical selected coordinates; collection independently rederives coordinates and matches artifact arm/context/personfold/representation/mode/state/source/program, not trust name only.
wire_rules.path_rule: Ordinary single-link files, no symlink ancestor/path traversal/absolute escapes; full emitted inventory no extra files; trusted copy to fresh capture.
wire_rules.failure_state: requested -> prepared -> launched -> completed -> collected -> admitted -> scored; every failure retains last state and original exception/exit. No completed=true on forced kill/EOF without original completion.
wire_rules.schema_status: Normative API design, no schemas or implementation imported/executed in this phase.
